title: Control-plane items name and link their merge commit, never a pull request number
description: The control plane is the merge writer and opens no pull request, so the number a control-plane candidate carries is its own change number, which on GitHub is somebody else's pull request. A control-plane item's plain status and candidate link name its commit — the merge commit once merged, the head before it — and never 'PR #N' or a /pull/ URL; pull-request-mode items keep theirs.
